cultural.vision_reason: The photo documents a group of women and children with body ornaments (lip-plugs, ear-plugs) seated before thatched mud-walled compound buildings, consistent with a documentary ethnographic photo of Anga daily life and dress in Nigeria.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, scene inside a compound. Group of circular, thatched-roof buildings, including, one with mud relief patterns on walls. Medium group of female adults and children sitting in front of buildings. Unclothed, adults wear a few personal-ornaments. Hill in background.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
